conditions: Classical ideal gas at equilibrium with positive absolute pressure, volume and absolute temperature; n is positive and units are consistent.
spoken_aliases: p v equals n r t

evidence: The classical ideal-gas equation of state is pV=N k_B T. The particle count satisfies N=n N_A and R=N_A k_B. Substitution gives pV=nRT. The equation is an idealized constitutive model, not a law for arbitrary dense or interacting gases.
Reference checked 2026-11-27: https://openstax.org/books/university-physics-volume-2/pages/2-key-equations. Proposed maintainer approval, not independent human certification.
